title: DM Automator
shortDescription: A Meta Graph API suite for automated, high-fidelity messaging pipelines.
fullDescription: DM Automator is a specialized enterprise-grade tool for managing high-volume messaging at scale. Built on the Meta Graph API, it provides robust automation for customer engagement, lead nurturing, and personalized communication workflows with built-in compliance and rate-limiting handles.

title: PromTix
shortDescription: Decentralized event infrastructure for the modern creator economy.
fullDescription: PromTix redefines event management by leveraging decentralized sovereign identity and secure digital ticketing. It eliminates fraud while providing creators with direct-to-fan engagement tools and programmatic secondary market controls.

title: Zenthous
shortDescription: Cognitive modeling for distributed autonomous agents.
fullDescription: Zenthous is our flagship research project focusing on multi-agent reinforcement learning in complex, high-stakes environments. It aims to bridge the gap between reactive systems and proactive cognitive agents for industrial applications.

title: Axero Core
shortDescription: The backbone of the Axero ecosystem, managing identity and flow.
fullDescription: Axero Core provides the foundational infrastructure for all our systems. It handles cross-protocol verification, secure data transit, and the unified control plane that powers our entire product suite.

title: Nexus Stream
shortDescription: Real-time semantic data processing for infinite scalability.
fullDescription: Nexus Stream is a specialized data pipeline architected for real-time semantic analysis. It transforms raw industrial data into structured, actionable insights using low-latency edge processing.
